description: This file defines a C interface for managing a dynamic array (vector) data structure, including creation, destruction, item access, insertion, removal, and comparison functionalities. It declares a struct for the vector, function pointer types for cleanup and comparison, and functions to operate on the vector.

methods.name: rtVector_Create
methods.description: Creates a new rtVector instance and initializes it.

methods.name: rtVector_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys a rtVector instance, optionally applying a cleanup function to each item.

methods.name: rtVector_PushBack
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the vector.

methods.name: rtVector_RemoveItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the vector, applying a cleanup function.

methods.name: rtVector_RemoveItemByCompare
methods.description: Removes items matching a comparison criterion, using a compare function.

methods.name: rtVector_At
methods.description: Accesses an item at a given index.

methods.name: rtVector_Size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the vector.

methods.name: rtVector_HasItem
methods.description: Checks if an item matching a comparison exists.

methods.name: rtVector_Find
methods.description: Finds an item matching a comparison criterion.

methods.name: rtVector_Cleanup_Free
methods.description: Internal cleanup function to free items.
